newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WELSH INTERNATIONAL DIES AT 33.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELSH INTERNATIONAL DIES AT 33.

text.p: Former Wales rugby international Carwyn Davies was found dead in his car at his home on Monday, police said.

Davies, 33, played in the centre and on the wing for Llanelli and made his international debut against Western Samoa in 1988. His three other caps came the following year against Scotland, Ireland and France.
He was coach of Llandovery at the time of his death.
There were no suspicious circumstances, police added..
